displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E2.3
meaning: 1st stage gas valve was not energized when it should be, and that fault was exceeded after 10 times.
causes: 1st stage gas valve not energized on a call when the control expected it
diySteps: Do not jumper the gas valve to force heat
Technician: the sequence says the 1st stage gas valve relay closes after ignitor warm-up. E2.3 is that valve not being energized
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E2.3 is the gas-valve circuit, not a filter code.
